name: Futaba Mikana
source:
Race: Witch
Breast: Normal

Kouhai of gardening club and a new witch who just began studying spirit magic this year. A hard worker who easily getting along with animals and hates ghost and horror.

An ojou-sama, but is modest and kind. Good at cleaning and tidying up.
